messages:
emma (sales): Hey team — Acme Merchant is requesting SOC 2 artifacts + a pen-test confirmation letter before we start their POC. They want a checklist and an ETA for delivery. Also asked whether evidence affects the Dedicated pricing quote. cc @ashwin @zara :eyes:

ashwin (solutions): Quick follow-ups: are they asking for the full SOC 2 Type II report, the attestation letter, or just the control mapping? often customers accept the attestation + SOC2 cert PDF.

zara (security): We can provide the SOC2 attestation PDF (2024) and our pentest confirmation letter. Need to confirm scope: does Acme require network-level penetration test results or application/infra?

emma (sales): I think procurement asked for "SOC2 attestation + penetration test letter confirming no critical findings in last 12 months". I'll paste their exact ask in a sec. They want materials by EOD Thu (72 hours).

mike (pricing): If they require on-prem or expanded data residency for the POC, that changes the Dedicated quote. Otherwise providing docs shouldn't affect base pricing. If they sign reserved capacity it could change legal terms.

ashwin (solutions): For the POC itself I need to know whether they want production-data-like traffic. If so we should include guidance on redaction and a short statement about our data handling during POC.

zara (security): Action items from security side: 1) confirm which pentest scope they expect 2) export SOC2 attestation PDF 3) prepare pentest confirmation letter (signed) 4) short KMS/key management factsheet. ETA: 24 hours for documents, 36-48 hours if they want signed pen-test report excerpts.

emma (sales): Here is the procurement snippet they sent: "We require SOC2 attestation, penetration test confirmation letter (no critical/critical-high findings), and evidence of encryption at rest and in transit. Doc delivery within 72 hours or POC delayed"

zara (security): Got it. We'll pull the attestation and draft the pen-test confirmation. I'll also add a 1-page KMS + encryption statement.

ashwin (solutions): I'll draft a short POC runbook explaining what telemetry we collect and suggested redaction steps. That should help legal/procurement sign off faster.

mike (pricing): Emma — if they push for a dedicated on-prem deployment for the POC, flag me immediately. Pricing change + lead time. Otherwise confirm they accept hosted Dedicated with contractual addendum, not full private deploy.

gdrive-bot: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/compliance/AcmeMerchant/SOC2_attestation_2024.pdf (permissions: sales+security)

zara (security): Uploaded draft pen-test confirmation to drive: https://drive.redwood.com/compliance/AcmeMerchant/Pentest_confirm_draft.docx — please review. Need legal signature before sending.

emma (sales): Thanks all. I'll respond to Acme: confirm we can deliver attestation + pen-test confirmation + KMS statement within 48 hours, ask to clarify if they need full pentest report or just the signed confirmation letter, and note no pricing change unless they request on-prem. Sending now. :thumbsup:

ashwin (solutions): If procurement asks for IP redaction template, point them to the runbook I'll attach.

zara (security): Will loop in legal for signature. Back to you once finalized.

emma (sales): Closing loop — Acme confirmed they only need the attestation + signed pen-test confirmation (no full report). They accepted hosted Dedicated for POC. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
